correctness.rationale: For GP(8,3) with 16 labeled vertices and 24 distinct edges, an edge matching is inclusion-maximal exactly when its unmatched vertex set is independent. Source recursive inclusion/exclusion visits each matching once and reports sizes 6:176, 7:336, 8:33 with none <=5. An independently implemented exhaustive combinations enumeration of all k-edge matchings confirmed 0 for k<=5 and the three counts. At each of 176 six-edge matchings, replace exactly one of six chosen graph edges by an unused edge, retaining only enumerated six-edge maximal matchings. Independent exchange adjacency yields 96 undirected pairs, degree distribution eighty vertices of degree0 and 96 degree2, and six connected 16-vertex cycles; six C16 plus 80 isolates, eccentricity8 within each nontrivial cycle. The pivot lemma: disjoint removed and inserted edges would allow the removed edge to append to new matching, contradiction. Original GP labeling and independent LCF complement verifier were read and checked; finite exhaustive proof is appropriate because the claim concerns a single finite graph.
